title: Children Education Allowance (CEA): Amount and Conditions
description: CEA is Rs 2,812.50 a month and hostel subsidy Rs 8,437.50 a month from 1 January 2024, for your two eldest children. See classes covered and claim rules.
applies_to: Central Government employees eligible for Children Education Allowance or hostel subsidy. KVS and Delhi Police apply the same DoPT orders through their own circulars and claim forms.
answer: Children Education Allowance (CEA) is Rs 2,812.50 a month, fixed, from 1 January 2024, and hostel subsidy is Rs 8,437.50 a month. For a Divyang child, CEA is Rs 5,625 a month. It is paid for your two eldest surviving children, from three classes before Class I up to Class XII.

sections.heading: CEA and Hostel Subsidy Amounts
sections.body_md:
| Item | Amount from 1 January 2024 |
|---|---|
| Children Education Allowance | Rs 2,812.50 per month (fixed) [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25.04.2024)](https://ropunjab.esic.gov.in/attachments/circularfile/Enclosure_English_1764582092.pdf) |
| Hostel subsidy | Rs 8,437.50 per month (fixed) [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25.04.2024)](https://ropunjab.esic.gov.in/attachments/circularfile/Enclosure_English_1764582092.pdf) |
| CEA for a Divyang child | Rs 5,625 per month (fixed) [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25.04.2024)](https://ropunjab.esic.gov.in/attachments/circularfile/Enclosure_English_1764582092.pdf) |

These amounts are 25% higher than before because DA reached 50% from 1 January 2024 [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25.04.2024)](https://ropunjab.esic.gov.in/attachments/circularfile/Enclosure_English_1764582092.pdf). Earlier the annual limits were Rs 27,000 for CEA and Rs 81,000 for hostel subsidy, with an automatic 25% rise each time DA reaches 50% [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.14)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/). At Rs 2,812.50 a month, CEA now works out to Rs 33,750 a year.

The amount is counted per child. The older KVS Accounts Code, for example, set CEA as a monthly amount for a child with an annual ceiling per child [(KVS Accounts Code (draft revision), CEA clause, PDF p. 121)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2024/05/2024053033.pdf#page=121).

sections.heading: Which Children and Classes Are Covered
sections.body_md:
- **Two eldest children.** CEA and hostel subsidy are admissible only for your two eldest surviving children. A third child is covered only if the second childbirth resulted in multiple births, or after a failed sterilisation operation [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.10)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/).
- **Classes.** From academic year 2023-24, CEA and hostel subsidy cover three classes before Class I up to Class XII, whatever the class is called [(DoPT OM dated 14.03.2024 as circulated by KVS on 12.05.2026, PDF p. 3)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2026/05/2026051331.pdf#page=3).
- **Diploma after Class X.** They also cover the first two years of a diploma or certificate course at a Polytechnic, ITI or Engineering College, if the child joins it after Class X and you did not get CEA or hostel subsidy for Classes XI and XII [(DoPT OM dated 14.03.2024 as circulated by KVS on 12.05.2026, PDF p. 3)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2026/05/2026051331.pdf#page=3).
- **NEP repeat year.** There is a one-time relaxation if your child had to repeat one extra class because of the National Education Policy 2020 [(DoPT OM dated 14.03.2024 as circulated by KVS on 12.05.2026, PDF p. 3)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2026/05/2026051331.pdf#page=3).
- **Repeating a class.** CEA can be claimed twice for the same class only if the child failed in that class [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.11)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/).
- **Distance learning.** CEA can be claimed for children studying by correspondence or distance learning [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.13)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/).

sections.heading: How to Claim
sections.body_md:
Reimbursement is made once a year, after the financial year ends [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.14)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/).

Delhi Police's claim form, issued under DoPT Order No. A-27012/02/2017-Estt.(AL) effective from 1 July 2017, uses a bonafide certificate from the head of the school [(Delhi Police CEA claim proforma, Annexure B, PDF p. 3)](https://delhipolice.gov.in/WelfareFiles/MISC/PROFORMA%20FOR%20RE-IMBURSEMENT%20OF%20CHILDREN%20EDUCATION%20ALLOWANCEHOSTEL%20SUBSIDY-english.pdf#page=3), or a self-declaration by the employee [(Delhi Police CEA claim proforma, self-declaration, PDF p. 4)](https://delhipolice.gov.in/WelfareFiles/MISC/PROFORMA%20FOR%20RE-IMBURSEMENT%20OF%20CHILDREN%20EDUCATION%20ALLOWANCEHOSTEL%20SUBSIDY-english.pdf#page=4).

If your spouse is also employed, the form asks you to certify that your spouse has not claimed and will not claim CEA for the same child [(Delhi Police CEA claim proforma, item 17, PDF p. 2)](https://delhipolice.gov.in/WelfareFiles/MISC/PROFORMA%20FOR%20RE-IMBURSEMENT%20OF%20CHILDREN%20EDUCATION%20ALLOWANCEHOSTEL%20SUBSIDY-english.pdf#page=2).

You cannot claim CEA for any period treated as dies non [(KVS Audit FAQ, Q.12)](https://kvsangathan.nic.in/en/auditpay-da-hra-cea-etc/).

sections.heading: Where to Check
sections.body_md:
The amounts are in DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25 April 2024 [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25.04.2024)](https://ropunjab.esic.gov.in/attachments/circularfile/Enclosure_English_1764582092.pdf). The classes covered are in DoPT OM of the same number dated 14 March 2024 [(DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 14.03.2024)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s35b8e4fd39d9786228649a8a8bec4e008/uploads/2024/03/202403261032034600.pdf), which modified para 2(P) of OM No. A-27012/02/2017-Estt.(AL) dated 17 July 2018 [(DoPT OM dated 14.03.2024 as circulated by KVS on 12.05.2026, PDF p. 3)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2026/05/2026051331.pdf#page=3).

KVS circulated the 14 March 2024 OM to its units on 12 May 2026 [(DoPT OM dated 14.03.2024 as circulated by KVS on 12.05.2026, PDF p. 1)](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s32d2ca7eedf739ef4c3800713ec482e1a/uploads/2026/05/2026051331.pdf#page=1). NVS and Delhi Police staff should follow their employer's circular and claim form.

faqs.q: How much is CEA per month now?
faqs.a: CEA is Rs 2,812.50 per month, fixed, from 1 January 2024, under DoPT OM No. A-27012/01/2023-Pers.Policy(Allowance) dated 25 April 2024.

faqs.q: What is the hostel subsidy amount?
faqs.a: Hostel subsidy is Rs 8,437.50 per month, fixed, from 1 January 2024.

faqs.q: Can I claim CEA for my third child?
faqs.a: No, unless the second childbirth resulted in multiple births or there was a failed sterilisation operation. CEA is for the two eldest surviving children only.

faqs.q: Is CEA available for nursery classes?
faqs.a: Yes. From academic year 2023-24, CEA covers three classes before Class I, whatever they are called, up to Class XII.

faqs.q: Can I claim CEA for a child doing a polytechnic or ITI diploma?
faqs.a: Yes, for the first two years of the course if the child joined after Class X and you did not claim CEA or hostel subsidy for Classes XI and XII.
